people.name: Aaron

people.name: Moses

translations.web: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.
translations.bsb: but he waved the breasts and the right thigh as a wave offering before the LORD, as Moses had commanded.
